title: ischaemum brachyatherum
intro: Ischaemum brachyatherum, commonly known as Khas or Khas-khas, is a type of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to act as a natural expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Ischaemum brachyatherum include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and the management of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
